name: The Window Box
source:
The Window Box is a surreal visual novel taking place in the home of Elsa Parelli. Elsa has invited her old college friends over for a relaxing morning, before a long-awaited day in the city. However, their plans are ruined when a massive unexpected storm hits, trapping them inside the home.

You’ll wander from room to room as a fly on the wall, while helping the women confront the conflict in their lives. For what is a house but a box with windows?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/950850/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
《窗盒》是一部发生在艾尔莎·帕莱利 (Elsa Parelli) 家中的超现实视觉小说。艾莎邀请她的大学老朋友来度过一个轻松的早晨，然后开始在这座城市度过期待已久的一天。然而，当一场意想不到的巨大风暴袭来时，他们的计划被毁了，他们被困在家里。

你将像墙上的苍蝇一样从一个房间走到另一个房间，同时帮助妇女们面对生活中的冲突。房子除了一个有窗户的盒子还有什么用呢？

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/950850/]Steam[/url]]
